sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emili. In this podcast,
we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words and ideas. Today, we travel
to Europe. We go to Germany. Our city today is Heidelberg. Heidelberg is calm. Heidelberg
is historic. Heidelberg is full of students and nature. Please relax. Please listen slowly.
Let's begin. Part 2. Germany and Europe. Germany is a country in Europe. It is a modern country.
It is also a historic country. Germany has many cities. Each city is different. Some cities
are big and busy. Some cities are calm and green. Heidelberg is not very big, but it is
very famous. Many people love this city. Part 3. Where is Heidelberg? Heidelberg is in the
southwest of Germany. It is in a region called Baden-Württemberg. The city is next to a
river. The river is called the Neckar River. There are hills and forests nearby. Nature is
very close. The city feels open and fresh. The air feels clean. Part 4. Weather and seasons.
Heidelberg has four seasons. In spring, flowers grow. Trees become green. In summer, days are warm.
People sit outside. In autumn, leaves change color. The city looks beautiful. In winter,
it can be cold. Sometimes there is snow. Life changes with the seasons. Part 5. A city with
long history. Heidelberg has a long history. People lived here many years ago. The city was
important in the past. It was a center of learning and culture. Many old buildings still stand today.
History is part of daily life. When you walk in Heidelberg, you walk through time. Part 6. Heidelberg
Castle. Heidelberg is famous for its castle. The castle is on a hill. It looks over the city. It
looks over the river. The castle is very old. Parts of it are in ruins. People visit the castle
every day. The view from the top is amazing. Part 7. The Old Town Heidelberg has a beautiful
Old Town. The streets are narrow. The houses are colorful. People walk slowly. They shop and talk.
There are cafes and small stores. Life feels calm and friendly. The Old Town is the heart of the
city. The Old Bridge Heidelberg has an old bridge. It is called the Old Bridge. The bridge
crosses the river. It connects parts of the city. People walk across the bridge. They stop and look
at the view. The bridge is a symbol of Heidelberg. It is very romantic.
Part 9. The University Heidelberg has a very famous university. It is the oldest university in
Germany. Students come from many countries. They study science, medicine, and art.
Because of students Heidelberg feels young and alive. Part 10. Daily life in Heidelberg.
Daily life in Heidelberg is relaxed. People work. People study. In the afternoon people walk. They
sit by the river. They drink coffee. Life is not very fast. People enjoy simple moments. The city
feels peaceful and safe. Part 11. Food and Culture. Food in Heidelberg is simple and warm.
People eat bread, soup, and meat. They also enjoy international food.
Students bring food from many cultures. People eat together. They talk and laugh. Culture is open.
People are friendly. Visitors feel welcome. Part 12. Nature Feeling and Goodbye.
Nature is very close to Heidelberg. There are forests and hills. There are walking paths.
People enjoy nature every day. They walk, relax, and think. Heidelberg is a city of history,
students, nature, and calm life. It is quiet. It is beautiful. It is full of soul.
